game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Harbor Docks, busy wooden harbor docks: the sailor must handle rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Nested Maze: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches.
theme: Coastal Port – Harbor Docks: busy wooden harbor docks
core_gameplay_loop: In Harbor Docks, repeat each round: Pick routes through nested if statements that branch inside branches. Each round, rogue crabs strike the cargo hold, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the route_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the cargo hold from rogue crabs in Harbor Docks: keep the route_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: route_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 29-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 3 (intro tier): Nested Maze
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested Maze' (Week 3 slot 6), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Harbor Docks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how route_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue crabs in Harbor Docks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 29 seconds while route_score > 0.
